to.description: The ids of the messages this reply answers; it is sent as an answer to the first

text.description: The reply, formatted by the channel's rules

awaits_answer.description: true when a reply asks the person a question or gives a plan that waits for their yes; vahtovik then keeps this session after a long pause

new_session.description: true when the person asked to clear the conversation or start over; the next message starts a new session
